rawContent: Thank you ⁦@THR for including my voice in this collection of essays from survivors looking back on the impact of the choices we made 5 years ago. ⁩ #MeToo, Five Years Later: Accusers Reflect – The Hollywood Reporter  https://t.co/tZRkswYZl3

“This hasn’t been an easy road, but in the process of saying #MeToo, I also set myself free, and freedom is an immeasurable win.” 

Thank you @THR @ThatRebecca for including my voice in this collection.
Please join me and @ECMcLaughlin tomorrow on her new #LivingThroughIt podcast to hear our convo about #MeToo at the intersection of race and gender. Thank you for having me, Elizabeth. 🎧🎧
Thank you @ashanti for your strength and courage. #MeToo

Johnny Depp has been embraced as a hero by unhinged right-wing misogynist extremists, and now he's been invited to appear in the @SavageXFenty show. Never expected such a powerful woman to succumb to the #MeToo backlash. Really disappointing @rihanna

I’d like to thank you guys for keeping me company during the pandemic, for sustaining my courage as I said #MeToo, for picking me up when I felt afraid, and for becoming my community of activists, survivors, news junkies & IRL friends. Plse DM me on IG, and let’s stay connected.
Honored and grateful that @OnTheRecordDoc is included in this list of films that explore various aspects of the #MeToo movement.

The #AdultSurvivorsAct window opened today, and I’m so grateful to @bradhoylman @LindaBRosenthal @GovKathyHochul @alisonturkos @MHoechstetter @EvelynYang @DonnaHylton @yuhline @SafeHorizon @PasstheASA for bringing accountability within reach for so many survivors. #MeToo

@MsPackyetti The #MeToo movement circa 2017 empowered victims to call out powerful abusers by name and is an example of much derided hashtag activism. It changed my life and the life of so many survivors, so the power of pre-Elon Twitter (flaws and all) was incredibly real. This is a loss.

Thank you @janaykingsberry for including my voice in this piece exploring the #MeToo movement from the perspective of Black survivors. #RIPToyinSalau 💔✊🏾
Five years after #MeToo, Black survivors mobilize for themselves. https://t.co/ROGzfc5Ggw
